correctness.rationale: The exact incremental divisor-count algorithm maintains E_p=v_p(n!/3) and T_q=v_q(tau(n!/3)); each step removes the factor E_p+1 and inserts the updated factor E_p+c+1, so the maintained violation count is zero exactly when tau(n!/3) divides n!/3. The inspected C++17 implementation uses exact integer arithmetic and a linear SPF sieve. An independent full replay through n=100,000,000 returned VERIFY_OK with 99,999,998 checked values and 1,002 direct Legendre-formula cross-checks. This is exhaustive only on the claimed finite interval and proves nothing beyond it.
residual_risks: The result is a finite verification, not an infinite proof of Colton’s conjecture.
